description: A build configuration makefile for compiling and configuring glibc version 2.38 within an OpenWrt build environment. It includes setup for cross-compilation, patching, and build steps.

methods.name: Host/SetToolchainInfo
methods.description: Sets toolchain information in info.mk using sed commands.

methods.name: Host/Configure
methods.description: Creates build directory, cleans previous config cache, and runs the GLIBC configure script.

methods.name: Host/Prepare
methods.description: Prepares the build environment and creates a symbolic link for the source directory.

methods.name: Host/Clean
methods.description: Removes build directories and development files related to glibc.
